view.en: First-person 3D shooter: the crosshair is at the centre, your weapon is at the bottom, and the status bar shows ammo, health, armour and the current weapon. The arena is a hall with pillars and low walls, with medical, armour and ammo pickups on the floor. Your gunner can only turn left and right: no looking up or down, no jumping

goal.en: Defeat every boss in the arena to win; you lose if your health reaches zero; each fight lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate; only pickups restore it

mouse.en: The mouse only turns the view left and right (X>0 turns right); there is no pitch

keys.en: hold to run (about twice as fast)
switch to the next weapon (same as K)

notes.en: Weapon order: shotgun, chaingun, plus a rocket launcher in scenes that have one. Switching lowers then raises the weapon, taking about a second during which you cannot fire

Shots go along the line through the crosshair, so turn to face the enemy first. The shotgun hits hard but fires slowly, the chaingun fires fast, and the rocket launcher does heavy damage with a blast radius, so avoid firing it point-blank
Fireballs and rockets are visible projectiles that you can dodge by strafing sideways; pillars and low walls block them and break line of sight
You can fire and turn while running. Enemies on the field may hurt each other, and each pickup can be taken only once

turn.en: horizontal turn by a fixed angle (no pitch)

options.fire_fresh: release then press fire (a fresh trigger pull)

summary.en: A huge hooved rocket gunner alone at the far end of a pillared hall, attacking only at range. You have a shotgun, chaingun and rocket launcher

tell.en: It aims an arm at you, then fires a rocket about every third of a second, three in total

effect.en: Rockets fly straight and explode on hitting you or a wall, hurting everything in the blast; the damage is high

counter.en: Strafe sideways or duck behind a pillar when you see the arm rise; rockets take time to arrive, so a step or two sideways misses

tell.en: When hit it sometimes stops and flinches briefly

effect.en: It does not attack during the stagger, which interrupts what it was doing

counter.en: Keep firing during the stagger; heavy weapons trigger it more often

summary.en: Two horned fiends with green flame appear together; they spit fireballs at range and claw up close. The hall is fairly open with a few pieces of cover

tell.en: It stops facing you for about half a second, then throws a green fireball

effect.en: The fireball flies straight and does moderate damage on hit; both may fire at once

counter.en: Strafe sideways or hide behind a pillar; fireballs do not home

tell.en: When you are right in front of it, it swipes instead of throwing a fireball

effect.en: Melee damage is very high and can take a large chunk of health in one hit

counter.en: Do not stand next to it; keep your distance and shoot while backing off

tell.en: Looks like the normal fireball but flies noticeably faster

effect.en: Same damage, but you have less time to react

counter.en: Strafe earlier or take cover in advance

phases.en: After one falls the other keeps attacking; both must be defeated to win

summary.en: A very large four-legged machine with a rapid-fire gun that walks slowly through a pillar-ringed arena. Its wide body is easy to hit

tell.en: It stops and aims at you for about a third of a second, then the muzzle flashes and it fires a stream, three pellets each time

effect.en: Hits instantly with no flight time; each pellet is weak but hits add up fast

counter.en: Strafing does not help; break line of sight behind a pillar, and it stops firing and walks after you

tell.en: As long as it can see you it keeps firing with almost no pause

effect.en: Standing in the open for long keeps draining your health

counter.en: Fight around the pillars: step out, fire a few shots, step back behind cover

summary.en: A fast flame-casting sorcerer accompanied by a few fire-throwing minions. The courtyard is full of pillars and low walls, which are the key to avoiding its flame

tell.en: It raises its hands and a column of flame appears next to you and follows you; about a second and a half later it bursts

effect.en: If it can still see you at the moment of the burst you take damage and are thrown up, with area damage around the flame

counter.en: Get behind a pillar or wall before the burst so it cannot see you; running in the open does not help

tell.en: It walks to a fallen fire-throwing minion, waves a hand, and the body rises again

effect.en: The revived minion returns at full health and keeps attacking

counter.en: Prioritise the sorcerer itself, and keep it away from bodies

tell.en: A fire-throwing minion stops and throws a fireball; up close it claws instead

effect.en: Fireballs and claws do low damage

counter.en: Strafe past fireballs; minions have little health and drop to one or two shotgun blasts

summary.en: A slow, huge-bellied brute with a cannon on each arm, alone in an open hall with pillars at the corners. You only have a shotgun and a chaingun

tell.en: It raises both cannons and pauses about half a second, then fires three rounds of two fireballs each, about a third of a second apart

effect.en: Fireballs fan out: one round leans left, one leans right, one brackets your position; each hit does moderate damage

counter.en: Strafe widely as it raises the cannons to slip through the gaps, or hide behind a pillar

tell.en: Between volleys it walks slowly toward you

effect.en: Its only attack is the volley; it has no melee

counter.en: Shoot while backing up, then strafe when it raises its cannons

summary.en: A skeleton with shoulder-mounted rocket launchers: little health but quick. The arena is a cloister of pillar rows, with several fire-throwing minions around. You only have a shotgun and a chaingun

tell.en: It raises the shoulder launcher, pauses about a third of a second, then releases a smoking missile that flies slowly

effect.en: The missile slowly turns to chase you and does moderate damage on hit

counter.en: Put a pillar between you and the missile so it hits the pillar; you can also shoot it down

tell.en: When you are very close it winds up an arm and swings about half a second later

counter.en: Do not stay in melee range; back away

tell.en: The surrounding fire-throwing minions stop and throw fireballs

effect.en: Fireballs do low damage; minions and the skeleton may hurt each other by accident

counter.en: Strafe aside, and clear nearby minions first if needed
